entries.en: to estimate and reckon; to calculate mentally, to conjecture (pensando, thinking over)
entries.notes: 西语词头栏标[残]，仅存 tracar；释义据 H'料計'、M 'liau siay: pensando'、R 'Liau soy'（料算）三栏互证。

entries.en: to count, reckon; to scheme, plot
entries.notes: M 栏末'ar did'片段未能确解，不影响'計＝算计谋划'本义（本页 16 条'計謀 guey bou'互证）。

entries.zh: 机谋、机巧（心机算计）；机关
entries.en: craft, scheming; contrivance, device
scheme, trick, set-up; situation
〔original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:昌/冒]两可、官话栏以'– – –'起头大半缺损，仅 M 'bou.' 清晰，疑为'冒'字而义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 设、布置安排；设局（设圈套）
entries.en: to set up, arrange, devise; to lay a trap
entries.notes: M 栏'fier giog iunzey'三音节、R 栏'cheuy sou x choay giau'与单字'設'不齐，拆分对读靠推断。

entries.zh: 请、邀请；请托恳求；设宴请客
entries.en: to invite, request, entreat; to give/host a feast
entries.notes: L 栏'tracarlo y hacer ~'与'請'的对应按'设宴办请'推断，对读不直接。

entries.en: to compare, reckon; to haggle, be calculating (kè-kàu)
entries.notes: L 栏'…para la vida y Iunzey cheto'断句不明；据 M 'cau : gey cau'（較／計較）定释义。

entries.en: to plot, scheme, contrive; plan, stratagem
established method or rule, ordinance; 'good contrivance' (buena traza)

entries.zh: 设局（设圈套陷害）、布置骗局
entries.en: to set a trap, to lay a plot, to rig a scheme

entries.zh: 实数、确数（数目属实）；夷數一说存疑
entries.en: exact or true figure, actual count; alternative reading (yíshù) uncertain
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:實數/夷數]两可，M 'prou sou' 对音不全合，按'實數'姑定。

entries.zh: 状局（构讼设局、捏状成局）
entries.en: contrived lawsuit, framed case (狀 complaint + 局 set-up)
entries.notes: '狀局'非习见复合词，按'状（诉状）+局（设局）'推断，不排除形近'妝局'（装局）之可能。

entries.en: to expect, anticipate; to suppose, imagine (pensando)
to estimate, gauge, reckon
scheme, stratagem, plot

entries.zh: 计较（计算较量、争多论少）
entries.en: to calculate, haggle; to squabble over trifles
entries.notes: L 栏'conollera aqfen'疑为误读或缩写残迹，据 M 'guey cau'（計較 kè-kàu）释义。

entries.zh: 机关（机巧构造、机括）；机谋圈套
entries.en: mechanism, contrivance; stratagem, trap
cunning plan, wily stratagem
resourcefulness, wise stratagem
situation, state of affairs; scale or aspect of affairs
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节调符 T99 污損難辨；字面'guiog bin'仍可读，按'局面'给释义、列低置信。

entries.en: quick-wittedness, resourcefulness; cunning (Sp. industria)
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节 T99 污損，且夹写西语 industria；按'机智'给释义、列低置信。
